'''Vendelik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Conquest of Makeb]].

==Biography==
Vendelik was the son of a [[Makeb]] mining foreman and joined the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in order to [[Conquest of Makeb|defend]] his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. However, he was mortally wounded by [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] forces, and was later found by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] strike team. Vendelik informed the Republic team that in order to stabilize the core, they had to reduce the pressure by venting the emergency release valves. Taking over the primary control center, the Republic team managed to vent the massive heat buildup in the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] core, buying enough time to obtain the fuel rods.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Private Vendelik was featured in the [[2013]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']] to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" /> His model was introduced in the SWTOR game files in version 1.3, but was only used for the game in the expansion 2.0, ''Rise of the Hutt Cartel''.<ref name="Jedipedia">{{WebCite|url=https://swtor.jedipedia.net/en/npc/private-vendelik|text=Private Vendelik|work=[[Jedipedia]]|archivedate=20200206185923}}</ref>
